name: Container freight
summary: Drewry container index $4,429 on 29 Oct, above the $4,000 Alert line
state: Drewry's World Container Index stood at $4,429 per 40ft container on 29 Oct, down 3% on the week but above the $4,000 Alert line (Drewry). Gulf disruption and rerouting keep capacity tight. The 5 Nov reading had not been found at the time of this check.
for_you: Higher shipping costs can raise prices of imported goods and delay deliveries.
basis_detail: Drewry World Container Index / Freightos Baltic Index
basis_by: Drewry World Container Index / Freightos Baltic Index

sources.title: Hellenic Shipping News — Drewry World Container Index

why: Container rates feed through to goods prices months later; spikes are an early inflation and supply-chain warning.
drivers: Chokepoint diversions, capacity, demand, port congestion, tariffs front-running.

rubric.normal: Drewry World Container Index < $2,500/FEU and 1-month change < +30%.
